$comment: Draft from docs/portfolio.md, 'Contracts'. Today the same facts are video-ads' `compute pacing` creative_demand and the agent's `space demand --n N` with the rest in --note; this is that as a file, to be settled by the first operator that writes it and the first maker that reads it.
title: ads.demand/1
description: What an operator needs from the makers: how many creatives, of which format and slot, by when.
x-rules: A request is a number of creatives wanted, not a promise to take that many: a maker answers with a plan of N, never padded.
The budget stays with the operator: a request carries a count and the cost of judging one creative, never a budget or a cap.
unit_cost is written with its currency or not at all; a figure is never converted to another currency.
An absent optional key means unknown, never null and never an empty string.

producer.description: The pack that wrote the document (its CLI word).

produced_at.description: When the document was written: ISO 8601 with its zone.

requests.description: What is wanted; empty when nothing is.

request_id.description: Unique in the document and stable across the documents that repeat the request, so a maker can say which request a creative answers.

platform.description: The platform the creatives are for (the operator's platform id, as in ads.creatives/1).

product.description: The product the creatives are for: a sku of catalog/1 when there is one.

format.description: The creative's format, in the operator's words (for example video_9x16).

slot.description: The placement the creative is for, when the platform has them.

needed_by.description: The day they are needed by, YYYY-MM-DD.

unit_cost.description: What it takes to judge one creative, in `currency`: the number above is the exploration money over this. Never a converted figure; written with its currency or not at all.

currency.description: The currency of unit_cost, ISO 4217 (CNY, USD, HKD). Present whenever unit_cost is.

window_days.description: The days the count is meant to cover.

note.description: Anything a person should read before making the creatives.
